scripts.build: apt-get install -y ffmpeg 2>/dev/null || true && npm install -g pnpm && npx pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && npx pnpm --filter @workspace/yt-auto-pro run build && npx pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
